contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete silver siliqua of Gratian. Mint is Trier, AD 367 -378, Reece period 19. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]RATIA[...]. Reverse shows seated figure left. Reverse legend is VRBS ROMA (not available in drop downs needs to be checked). Reverse fields and exergue reads: / //TRPS.
